hook: Bet on size: in every Duel the bigger unit takes from the smaller, and it all pours into one champion.
loop: Duel on your own board, in the shop and against the enemy.
Stats flow up into your champion, standing alone with empty neighbours.
A huge champion, doubled by Lord of the Old Lek, wins fights alone.

growth.line: Board duels just move stats; shop and enemy duels add a quarter, half with Keeper, twice with Cantor.

feel.early: Squires feed one unit; few real gains yet
feel.mid: Raid the shop: refreshes and duels become growth
feel.late: Pilgrim or Ottokar give a big finish

stars.why: Both outcomes pay: grow your unit, or let the shop win and buy it.
Empty slots become power and hero damage for a lone champion.
The capstone the shop raid is built to reach.

card_short.u01: Start of Combat: duels the enemy across.
card_short.u02: Duels your biggest unit each turn; grows if it loses.
card_short.u03: Duels the biggest shop unit it beats; again on refresh.
card_short.u04: Gold when you win a duel; buffs bought duel winners.
card_short.u05: Your biggest duels your second-biggest each turn; winner grows.
card_short.u06: Duels each target before attacking; first loss each fight free.
card_short.u07: Selling a unit gives your champion half its stats.
card_short.u08: When played: duels your pick, board or shop; victor +3/+3.
card_short.u09: Your duel winners gain +1/+1, also in fights.
card_short.u10: Duels the shop's biggest on refresh; beaten units cost less.
card_short.u11: Start of Combat: your champion duels the enemy's biggest.
card_short.u12: Champion grows each turn for every empty slot beside it.
card_short.u13: Duel winners take half instead of a quarter.
card_short.u14: Duels enemy attackers first, three times a fight.
card_short.u15: Doubles a lone champion; empty slots count for hero damage.
card_short.u16: Every duel your units start happens twice.
card_short.u17: Champion duels every enemy, smallest first, until it would lose.
card_short.u18: Champion duels the whole shop each turn and on refreshes.
card_short.u19: Copies every other unit's permanent gains onto your champion.

builds.name: The Lone Champion
builds.line: Squires feed one champion with empty neighbours; Lord doubles it.

builds.name: Raiding the Wagons
builds.line: Refreshes become growth; beaten shop units come cheap. Trades tempo for scaling.

builds.name: The Tourney
builds.line: Several mid-sized duelists take pieces in fights; Cantor doubles it.

liked: Edge-Strutter makes losing on purpose real: let the shop win, then buy it.
One duel rule on board, shop and fight; unlike any of today's tribes.
worries: Pilgrim with Keeper and Cantor passes the Tier 6 ceiling; Ottokar may decide fights.
Lord of the Old Lek: empty slots may make every win deal full damage.
changed: Elder of the Centre no longer loops; Cantor rewritten so it reads.
Fence-Line Challenger only duels what it beats; Reisig buffs bought units that beat yours.
Grit Pit Elder's fight wins now grow permanently; Hartmut's first lost duel is free.
verdict: Rated 7 fun and 7 distinct, it ranked first of its seed's three; for players who love feeding one huge champion.
